bus_clerk.text: Bus Office. Buses to Tralee and Killarney and every beautiful road between. Tickets on the left, sympathy on the right.
There was a railway here once. The Tralee and Dingle Light Railway ran from 1891 until 1953, and it was said to be the most westerly in Europe.
The Slea Head Drive circles the tip of the peninsula. Take the bus. The roads are narrow and the sheep have right of way.
